positive_finite.statement: Ratings, inductance, capacitance, SCR, and ESCR used by this derivation must be finite and strictly positive.
positive_finite.limitation: This invariant declares no reviewed upper bound and no SCR or ESCR threshold.

rating_contract.statement: The six base LCC ratings are required; ESCR is optional.

catalog_structure_contract.statement: The versioned catalog must retain every required feasibility relationship and bipolar return-topology contract binding.

angle_domain_deg.statement: Control angles are represented in degrees in the open mathematical domain 0 < angle < 180.
angle_domain_deg.limitation: This is a representation domain, not an acceptable operating range.

strict_order.statement: A declared minimum firing angle must be strictly less than its declared maximum firing angle.

dimensional_identity.statement: dc_power_mw = dc_voltage_kv * dc_current_ka because kV multiplied by kA yields MW.

unit_conversions.statement: H to mH and F to uF use SI decimal-prefix multipliers; rad to deg uses 180/pi.

floating_point_comparison.limitation: These tolerances handle floating-point comparison only and are not engineering acceptance margins.

legacy_catalog_defaults.limitation: These inherited defaults are default values only and do not establish allowable ranges.

bipole_return_contract.limitation: Asset identifiers are structural declarations, not proof of electrical acceptance.

inverter_commutation_identity.statement: For gamma >= gamma_min, alpha is bounded above by 180 - gamma_min - mu; feasibility requires the user firing-angle interval to intersect this upper-bounded interval.
inverter_commutation_identity.limitation: The derived value is a maximum feasible bound, not an actual firing-angle operating point or an empirical control margin.
